A3's prefactor can produce the zero only by a NON-structural factor tuned to q*, which the anti-fit discipline forbids as a derivation. This confirms the campaign's representational conclusion from the prefactor side. scope-(a): excludes the obvious natural candidates (magnitude/shape), NOT a proof that no factor exists; a future structural object with a zero at q* would reopen it.
